shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md
printf '\\n--- test commands ---\\n'
sed -n '1,240p' .lore/test-commands.yml
printf '\\n--- specs ---\\n'
rg --files specs | sort
printf '\\n--- websocket tests ---\\n'
rg --files src | rg '(test|spec)\\.(ts|tsx)"'$|/ws/'"' | sort | sed -n '1,240p'
printf '\\n--- git ---\\n'
git status --short --branch && git log --oneline -5"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
printf '\\n--- ws protocol ---\\n'
sed -n '1,360p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
printf '\\n--- existing transport test patterns ---\\n'
sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
printf '\\n--- resume e2e ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts
printf '\\n--- config/server ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/createServer.ts && sed -n '1,220p' src/config.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -C 3 'list_conversations|conversation_list|Conversation list|history|UNSUPPORTED|StoreCannotList' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
printf '\\n--- ws tests setup excerpts ---\\n'
sed -n '1,220p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
printf '\\n--- validation ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
printf '\\n--- handler ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts
printf '\\n--- support ---\\n'
rg --files src/transport | rg 'wsTestSupport' && sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts
printf '\\n--- package scripts ---\\n'
node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '100,180p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '180,270p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '270,410p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
printf '\\n--- messages/types/store ---\\n'
sed -n '1,280p' src/types/messages.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/types/sessionStore.ts
sed -n '1,220p' src/infrastructure/stores/inMemorySessionStore.ts
printf '\\n--- sender ---\\n'
sed -n '1,180p' src/transport/ws/sender.ts
printf '\\n--- prettier ---\\n'
ls -a | rg 'prettier' && (cat .prettierrc 2>/dev/null || true)"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' src/config.test.ts
rg -n \"provider:.*mock|type: 'mock'|Mock\" src -g '*.test.ts' | head -80
rg -n \"export.*Mock|mock\" src/providers/providerFactory.ts src/providers/mock -g '*.ts'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "test -f .lore/dod.md && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/dod.md || true
rg -n \"class .*Store|listFor\\?\" src/transport -g '*.test.ts' src -g '*.test.ts' | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '70,220p'
printf '\\n--- test file syntax check context ---\\n'
sed -n '1,260p' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files scripts | rg 'reanchor|repoint|spec' && nl -ba src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '96,205p' && git diff --check && git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git diff --stat
git diff -- .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | sed -n '1,260p'
git status --short --branch"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "test(transport): define conversation list acceptance" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
